findings.title: Missing Machine-Readable /llms.txt Endpoint
findings.evidence: GET https://www.nbcuniversal.com/llms.txt returned HTTP status FAILED

suggested_action.summary: Deploy an /llms.txt file providing clean Markdown context for LLM agents
suggested_action.impact: Improves RAG parsing efficiency for AI assistants like Perplexity and ChatGPT
suggested_action.code_snippet:

findings.title: Missing Schema.org Entity Metadata (Brand/ItemList JSON-LD)
findings.evidence: 0 JSON-LD blocks containing 'Brand', 'Organization', or 'ItemList' schemas were found

suggested_action.summary: Embed structured Schema.org JSON-LD to assist entity resolution
suggested_action.impact: Helps AI crawlers extract authoritative entity relationships and product collections

findings.title: Missing Schema.org dateModified Provenance Timestamp
findings.evidence: JSON-LD graph contains no 'dateModified' attribute to verify factual recency

suggested_action.summary: Add ISO 8601 'dateModified' property to Organization/Product JSON-LD
suggested_action.impact: Overrides legacy cached vector embeddings in AI model memory with authoritative timestamps

findings.title: Deficit in Cross-Domain Corroboration Graph (Missing Wikidata sameAs)
findings.evidence: Found 0 sameAs links, but 0 point to Wikidata, Wikipedia, or Crunchbase

suggested_action.summary: Add 'sameAs' array pointing to verified Wikidata and Crunchbase entity IDs
suggested_action.impact: Increases cross-node consensus score, enabling AI models to validate entity rebranding

findings.title: Stateless Referral Routing (Missing AI Referrer Context Bridge)
findings.evidence: No static DOM scripts or Edge header inspect rules detected for AI referrer domains (e.g., chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai).

suggested_action.summary: Deploy Edge Middleware / Frontend Context Bridge to inspect Referer headers and render personalized banners.
suggested_action.impact: Eliminates state loss when users click citations, preserving pre-conditioned intent upon site entry.

findings.title: Missing Heading ID Anchors for Deep AI URL Citation Linking
findings.evidence: Found 6 headings (<h1-h6>), but 0 have explicit 'id' attributes for URL hash deep-linking.

suggested_action.summary: Assign explicit, human-readable 'id' attributes to all major section headings.
suggested_action.impact: Allows AI assistants to construct exact hash citation links (e.g., page.html#specifications) preventing scroll state loss.

proactive_recommendations: Deploy a root /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt markdown index to provide RAG systems with clean brand context.
Include high-authority sameAs links (e.g., Wikidata, Wikipedia, Crunchbase) inside Schema.org/Organization JSON-LD markup.
Structure room types, amenities, and policies using Schema.org/Hotel and Schema.org/Accommodation JSON-LD.
Ensure check-in policies and room specifications exist in plain text above the fold rather than inside client-side JS accordions.
